Basic text-to-speech generation

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.speech_async(LiterLlm::CreateSpeechRequest.new(input: 'Hello, world!', model: 'tts-1', voice: 'alloy'))
puts result.inspect
```
